subject: RM_Salvecomb
departures: exactly one frond per plant, a single arched blade, never a clump or rosette of fronds
the frond is one solid blade, not divided into leaflets, and one edge carries a row of evenly spaced, comb-like serrated teeth
silver-white down mats the toothed edge, while the rest of the blade stays bare
a tall, waist-high single arch rising from the ground, standing alone with no neighbouring plants
